title: EMC 文档
introduction:
The following table list typical design changes and show EMC retest is required. When the design team proposes a change the testing requirements can be easily determined. For some tests an EMC analysis will be required to determine the risks.
下表列出了一些典型的设计变更，并指出了EMC需要重新测试的项目。当设计团队计划做一些设计变更时，可以很方便的决定需要进行哪些测试。有些测试需要一份分析报告来评估风险性。
legend:
X= This EMC Test is definitely required. “X”=需要测试的项目
(X)= An EMC analysis is necessary to determine if this test is required. “（X）”=需要做一份分析报告来评估是否需要做这项测试

Equipment: a previously certified component, sub assembly, subsystem, or system.
设备：以前曾经认证过的零件，子部件，子系统，或系统
